scenarios.title: All Random
scenarios.hypothesis: Pure noise; attendance hovers near goProb*N with binomial variance.

scenarios.title: All Threshold
scenarios.hypothesis: Threshold rule on history avg; expect rapid bistable swings or lock-on.

scenarios.title: All Moving Average
scenarios.hypothesis: Same w=5 window; uniform behavior breeds period-2 oscillation.

scenarios.title: All Adaptive
scenarios.hypothesis: Self-adjusting threshold should converge near capacity.

scenarios.title: All Contrarian
scenarios.hypothesis: Everyone copies the opposite of last round → catastrophic over/undershoot.

scenarios.title: All Trend Follower
scenarios.hypothesis: Chases gradient; expect runaway then crash.

scenarios.title: All Loyal
scenarios.hypothesis: Fixed on/off schedule; attendance = (on/(on+off))*N deterministically.

scenarios.title: All Regret Minimizing
scenarios.hypothesis: Online learning should approach mixed-strategy equilibrium.

scenarios.title: Contrarians vs Threshold majority
scenarios.hypothesis: Contrarian minority should profit by going when threshold-flock avoids.

scenarios.title: Regret-Min vs Trend Followers
scenarios.hypothesis: Learners should exploit trend-followers as predictable.

scenarios.title: Adaptive vs Random
scenarios.hypothesis: Adaptive should ride noise; random contributes ~Bin(50, p) variance.

scenarios.title: Loyal anchors + Moving-Avg crowd
scenarios.hypothesis: Deterministic loyal block injects regular signal that MA echoes.

scenarios.title: Full ecology (all 8 strategies)
scenarios.hypothesis: Heterogeneity dampens oscillations; expect noisy band near capacity.

scenarios.title: Full ecology @ capacity 30%
scenarios.hypothesis: Same 8-way mix at capacity=30; attendance should track capacity, efficiency varies.

scenarios.title: Full ecology @ capacity 50%
scenarios.hypothesis: Same 8-way mix at capacity=50; attendance should track capacity, efficiency varies.

scenarios.title: Full ecology @ capacity 70%
scenarios.hypothesis: Same 8-way mix at capacity=70; attendance should track capacity, efficiency varies.

scenarios.title: Full ecology @ capacity 85%
scenarios.hypothesis: Same 8-way mix at capacity=85; attendance should track capacity, efficiency varies.

scenarios.title: Steady churn (Poisson in, binomial out)
scenarios.hypothesis: Random in/out keeps active count near equilibrium; attendance variance grows.

scenarios.title: Linear growth — fade-in arrivals only
scenarios.hypothesis: Population swells from 30 to ~100 over fade-in; attendance climbs in lockstep.

scenarios.title: Crowd fade-out rounds 50→100
scenarios.hypothesis: Departures kick in mid-game and ramp down; attendance drops along with active count.

scenarios.title: Festival shock — arrivals only rounds 10–30
scenarios.hypothesis: Burst of arrivals concentrated in window; attendance spikes then settles.

scenarios.title: Late bloom — empty until round 40
scenarios.hypothesis: Bar empty first 40 rounds, then ramps up. Tests whether learners adapt to regime change.

scenarios.title: Volatile uniform flows
scenarios.hypothesis: Wide uniform arrivals (0–12) + uniform departures (0–10) → large active-count swings.

scenarios.title: Gamma heavy-tail arrivals
scenarios.hypothesis: Gamma(shape=1.5, mean=5) produces occasional big arrival bursts.

scenarios.title: Slow collapse (departures > arrivals)
scenarios.hypothesis: Population steadily dwindles to floor; attendance drops with it.
